tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: rtsa gsum dgongs 'dus zab mo gter gyi mdzod las: rig 'dzin rgyun gyi rnal 'byor bzhugs:

rtsa gsum yongs rdzogs lha la 'dud: rig 'dzin mchog gi sgrub pa yi: yang zab rgyun gyi rnal 'byor ni: sgrub rten phyi nas mi btsal te: rang lus lhun grub gzhal yas khang: rtsa rlung thig le rtsa gsum lha: sems nyid khyab brdal chos kyi dbyings: pad+ma thod phreng rtsal du bzhugs: de ltar shes pa'i rnal 'byor pas: dben par bde ba'i stan la 'dug: lus gnad bsrang zhing rlung ro bsal: mos gus drag pos mtshams sbyar nas: sngon dngos rjes kyis nyams su blang: sa ma ya: sngon 'gro rgyud sbyong rim pa ni: na mo: ka dag dbyings nas shar ba'i rtsa gsum lhar: lhun grub rang ngo shes pas skyabs su mchi: zung 'jug bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i rnal 'byor gyis: khams gsum 'gro kun sgrol bar sems bskyed do: gnyis su med pa'i tshul gyis gus phyag 'tshal: chos nyid rig rtsal mchod sprin rgya mtshos mtshod: sdig ltung 'dus ma byas pa'i ngang du bshags: zag med dge tshogs rgya mtshor yi rang ngo: 'chi med gnyug ma'i ngang du rtag bzhugs nas: brjod bral don gyi chos 'khor bskor bar bskul: dge tshogs 'od gsal snying po'i dbyings su bsngo: 'gro kun rang byung ye shes sku thob shog: hūm̐ hūm̐: gzung 'dzin bgegs tshogs spros bral dbyings su dengs: mi phyed rdo rje'i srung 'khor lhun gyis grub: bde chen lhan skyes mchog gi byin phob la: snod bcud ye shes chen por byin gyis rlobs: hūm̐ badz+ra rak+ṣa bh+rūm̐: dz+nyā na ā be sha ya a ā: oṃ āḥhūm̐: sa ma ya: dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor zab mo ni: a: skye med dbyings las 'gag med ye shes rtsal: ma bcos lhun grub dag pa rab 'byams zhing: bde chen thig ler 'khyil ba'i gzhal yas dbus: rang rig zhal phyag skur bzhengs pad+ma 'byung: dkar dmar mdangs ldan gzhon tshul khro 'dzum nyams: phyag g.yas rdo rje g.yon pas thod bum bsnams: kha ṭ+wāṃ 'khril zhing pad zhu brjid ldan gsol:

gsang phod chos gos za 'og ber chen bklubs: mtshan dpes rab brgyan 'ja' zer thig le'i klong: rdo rje'i skyil krung pad nyi zla steng bzhugs: lus kyi dkyil 'khor rang byung pho brang che'i: rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga ldan spyi bo'i dbus: kun bzang yab yum dgongs brgyud bla mas bskor: mgrin par rigs gsum bka' babs slob dpon bzhi: brda' brgyud rig 'dzin bye ba bsam yas 'phro: thugs kar dwangs ma mi shigs rdo rje chos: dmar gsal rdo rje dril 'dzin yum dang 'khril: tshogs brgyad dag pa'i snying ga'i rtsa 'dab tu: dpal chen grub pa brgyad kyi rig 'dzin bzhugs: ro ma'i cha la bde chen man+dā ra: rkyang ma'i dbus su dbyings phyug mtsho rgyal yum: lte bar bka' babs rje 'bangs nyi shu lngar: dus gsum snyan brgyud bla ma sprin ltar gtibs: gsang gnas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshom bur brdal: gzhan yang rdo rje'i phung po'i maṇ+ḍa lar: rig 'dzin slob dpon yi dam zhi khro'i lha: phyi nang mkha' 'gro chos srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs: nyi ma dang ni 'od zer ji bzhin du: ma bskyed lhun grub 'od skur lam mer gsal: rang byung rdo rje gsum ldan ye shes lngar: gdod nas mngon par byang chub dbang bskur rdzogs: gzhi lus dam tshig rig stong ye shes pa: dbyer med rang bzhin lhun grub phyag rgya cher: gnyis med mnyam pa'i ngang du brda phyag 'tshal: yul dang dbang po zung 'jug bde bas mchod: rdo rje mi shigs nā da'i dbyangs kyis bstod: bde chen ye shes dzap kyi phrin las bskul: 'chi med don gyi rtsa gsum 'grub gyur cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra ma hā gu ru dz+nyā na ma hā su kha āt+ma ko3 haṃ: rang snang rig ma'i bde ba las: rlung sems lha skur ro mnyam pa'i: gsal snang bzung zhing nga rgyal brtan: bzlas pas ye shes bskul bar bya: hūm̐ hrī: thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' rdo rje chos: de yi thugs dbus nyi zla kha sbyor sbubs:

hrīḥmathar bde chen sngags kyi phreng bas bskor: 'od zer 'phro 'dus dgongs brgyud bla ma yi: 'od gsal byin rlabs rig stong hrīḥl thim: ston 'khor dgongs pa dbyer med dbang thob gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dz+nyā na dhā tu ā: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: snying po sngags las 'phros pa'i 'od zer gyis: rtsa gsum rgyal ba mchod cing dngos grub bsdus: bdag la thim pas nyams rtogs rig rtsal rgyas: dkyil 'khor kun gyi dbang phyug chen por gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi hūm̐: slar yang 'od zer bde chen ye shes kyis: brda brgyud rig 'dzin bla ma'i thugs dam bskul: mkhyen brtse nus ldan dbang gi chu bos smin: dpal chen byin rlabs mi shigs thig ler 'khyil: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra ma hā gu ru sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: gsang mtshan sngags kyis snyan brgyud bla ma dang: rtsa gsum rab 'byams thugs rje'i gzi byin bskul: snod bcud lha sngags ye shes rol pa'i ngang: mchog thun phrin las lhun gyis grub par gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥbadz+ra gu ru pad+ma thod phreng rtsal dhe ba dhā ki nī badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥsid+dhi pha la hūm̐ ā: shīn+taṃ puṣ+ṭiṃ bā shaṃ mā ra ya phaṭa: lha nyid sngags su shar ba'i me: bzlas brjod ting 'dzin rlung gis bskul: sgrib pa'i bud shing kun bsregs nas: ye shes snang ba rgyas par 'gyur: hūm̐ hrī: rtsa gsum dkyil 'khor rab 'byams dbyings nas bzhengs: dgongs pas byin rlobs dbang bzhi'i chu rgyun phob: smin cing grol ba'i ye shes mthar phyin nas: lha dang rtog pa dbyer med dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī sarba a bhi ṣiñca sid+dhi pha la hūm̐: lus dkyil lha rnams thams cad kun: snyoms zhugs bde chen ye shes 'bar: bde bas thabs byas stong pa nyid: ma bcos rdzogs pa chen po 'o:

sa ma ya: bza' btung tshogs kyi bdud rtsis mchod: oṃ āḥhūm̐: bza' bca' btung ba'i rdo rje'i dam tshig rdzas: bde chen ye shes bdud rtsi'i longs spyod ches: dkyil 'khor bdag po pad+ma thod phreng mchod: spyi bo'i dgongs brgyud rgyal ba rgya mtsho mchod: mgrin pa'i brda brgyud bye ba bsam yas mchod: snying ga'i ye shes klong dgu'i rig 'dzin mchod: lte ba'i dus gsum snyan brgyud bla ma mchod: gsang gnas dpa' bo dhā ka'i tshom bu mchod: phung khams skye mched rtsa gsum rab 'byams mchod: dgyes mnyam mchog gi mchod pa 'di bzhes la: tshogs chen gnyis rdzogs sku bzhi'i dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru dhe ba dhā ki nī sarba maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri bā ra ma hā su kha ga ṇa tsakra pū dza ho: yul snang dpa' bo dhā ki nīs: bde chen rdo rje'i glu gar sgyur: bdag nyid lha sku rjes chags kyis: snyoms zhugs bde stong ye shes 'bar: dz+nyā na gī ti hrī: badz+ra nirti ā: e waṃ ma hā su kha a haṃ: rmad byung tshogs kyi mchod pa yis: nyams chag rtog sgrib dbyings su zhi: bde chen ye shes rig rtsal rgyas: lhan skyes sku bzhi mngon gyur shog: de ltar rtag tu brtson pa yis: zas kyi bu lon sgrib pa dag: 'brel tshad gegs zhi bde chen 'phel: rdo rje'i rigs gcig 'grub par 'gyur: sa ma ya: rjes su rtag chad mtha' bsal phyir: a: rang snang lha sku sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i tshogs: mkha' la sprin bzhin 'od gsal dbyings su thim: zung 'jug rnam thar gsum ldan pad+ma 'byung: lha sngags chos sku'i phyag rgya chen por bzhengs: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: bsngo smon shis brjod mtshams sbyar bya: ho: bskyed rdzogs zab mo'i rnal 'byor la brten nas: 'gro kun 'chi med rtsa gsum lha tshogs dang: mi phyed mngon par byang chub ye shes kyis: dngos grub dpal la rol ba'i bkra shis shog: thun mtshams bde stong lha sku dang:

dbyings rig dbyer med lam khyer bya: sa ma ya: zab mo'i rnal 'byor snying po 'di: sngon chad gzhan du ma bstan par: lo chen thugs kyi sras la gdams: rtse gcig nyams longs gter du sbos: skye ba'i mtha' dang 'phrad nas kyang: skal ldan smin grol dpal du 'gyur: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: gtad rgya: rgya rgya rgya: kha thaṃ: gu h+ya: 'chi med bstan gnyis g.yung drung gling pas lha mdo 'bur mo brag nas dngos grub tu thob pa'o// //
